2609.30446.title: Predicting Transmembrane Protein Topology from 3D Structure
2609.30446.paper_summary: This paper presents a novel approach to infer protein topology using the state-of-the-art graph neural network (GNN), SchNet. The model is trained on the same dataset used to develop the recent DeepTMHMM model with 5-fold cross-validation. Unlike the conventional approaches based on using only the protein sequences or the $α$-carbons as features, we have decoded our classifier in this way, so all atom-level embeddings are used. Without applying any pre-trained weight, the final results have shown great potential that GNNs can be used for topological predictions.
2609.30446.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了一種新穎的方法，利用最先進的圖神經網絡（GNN）SchNet 來推斷蛋白質的拓撲結構。該模型在與最近的 DeepTMHMM 模型開發相同的數據集上進行了 5 倍交叉驗證的訓練。與僅使用蛋白質序列或 $α$-碳作為特徵的傳統方法不同，我們以這種方式解碼了我們的分類器，因此使用了所有原子級的嵌入。最終結果顯示，在未應用任何預訓練權重的情況下，GNN 在拓撲預測方面具有很大的潛力。
2609.30446.author: Sitong Chen et.al.
